544:t_2:336.en:
$$レナード$$
「But if the distorted history is corrected, she will live her life as an ordinary human.」

544:t_2:337.en:
$$レナード$$
「No one will target her. She'll live in peace, fall in love, have children, and grow old...」

544:t_2:338.en:
$$レナード$$
「Exactly as you wish. This is the only solution.」

544:t_2:339.en:
$$宗介$$
(What this man says may well be right... But...)

544:t_2:341.en:
$$宗介$$
(In the corrected history... I'm not at the side of $$千鳥$$, who lives a happy life...)

544:t_2:342.en:
$$宗介$$
(To begin with, $$千鳥$$ and I never meet... A world like that has no value to me...)

544:t_2:343.en:
$$レナード$$
「...This truce is about to end.」

544:t_2:344.en:
$$レナード$$
「Now we have our way out.」

544:t_2:345.en:
$$宗介$$
(If this man's plan truly can be realized, isn't it the only option for returning $$千鳥$$ to a peaceful world...?)

544:t_2:346.en:
$$宗介$$
($$千鳥$$... What should I do...)

544:t_2:347.en:
$$レナード$$
「Well now... Shall we start killing each other?」

544:t_2:349.en:
$$レナード$$
「Fine. Then let's work off our mutual frustration another day.」

544:t_2:351.en:
$$レナード$$
「One last thing. I will see my goal through even if it means turning the whole world against me.」

544:t_2:352.en:
$$レナード$$
「If you stand by and do nothing, that's fine. But the next time you appear before me, I will show no mercy. I will kill you with everything I have.」

544:t_2:354.en:
$$宗介$$
(Either way, all I can do now is find $$千鳥$$ before he does...)

544:t_2:358.en: ～ $$ヤムスク１１$$ Underground Facility: Deepest Level ～

544:t_2:360.en:
$$テッサ$$
(So this is... the deepest level... The central point where the Tau waves are projected.)

544:t_2:361.en:
$$かなめ$$
($$テッサ$$'s consciousness and mine... are melting together...)

544:t_2:362.en:
$$テッサ$$
(It must be a phenomenon similar to resonance...)

544:t_2:364.en:
$$かなめ$$
(She's the test subject from 18 years ago... I don't know who she is, but...)

544:t_2:365.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Even so, why is her body in this state?)

544:t_2:366.en:
$$かなめ$$
(No... Her original body decayed away long ago.)

544:t_2:367.en:
$$かなめ$$
(What's here is the remnant of her existence... Over a long span of years, her spirit made it manifest through the $$オムニ・スフィア$$...)

544:t_2:368.en:
$$かなめ$$
(This remnant of hers is the Whisperer... Someday, in some future no one can know, she will revive and rule the me of now with an even greater power...)

544:t_2:369.en:
$$かなめ$$
(That's why I'm destroying this place... That's $$テッサ$$'s goal...)

544:t_2:370.en:
$$かなめ$$
(If we just destroy this catalyst, which converts Tau waves arriving from another era and radiates them, $$ヤムスク１１$$ will be freed from that curse...)

544:t_2:371.en:
$$かなめ$$
(But the same crystal will eventually grow back... It doesn't solve the root problem.)

544:t_2:372.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I can't stop the Whisperer from appearing... Then...)

544:t_2:373.en:
???
(You understand perfectly, my daughter. Well done coming here.)

544:t_2:374.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I know that voice. I have for a long, long time...)

544:t_2:375.en:
???
(Yes... I was waiting for you to come. I have called to you many times before... And every time, you resisted and shut your ears to my voice.)

544:t_2:376.en:
???
(But this was decided long ago... You have come here. You can no longer refuse me.)

544:t_2:378.en:
???
(There is nothing left to fear... Reach out your hand, open your heart...)

544:t_2:379.en:
???
(Embrace infinite pleasure in your heart, together with joy.)

544:t_2:381.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$カナメ$$! I'm going to destroy this capsule! Please stand back!」

544:t_2:383.en:
$$かなめ$$
「There's no need for that anymore.」

544:t_2:385.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Let's go, $$テッサ$$. There's nothing left for us here...」

544:t_2:391.en:
$$宗介$$
(Something is wrong... Is that really $$千鳥$$...?)

544:t_2:394.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I have a gun. If you move, I'll shoot $$テッサ$$.」

544:t_2:395.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm sorry, $$相良$$... I didn't anticipate this...」

544:t_2:396.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But I think $$カナメ$$ probably...」

544:t_2:397.en:
$$かなめ$$
「No, $$テッサ$$. Don't just go rambling on your own.」

544:t_2:398.en:
$$宗介$$
「What is going on? It's me, $$千鳥$$. Don't you recognize me?」

544:t_2:399.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Of course I do. It's been a while, $$宗介$$.」

544:t_2:400.en:
$$宗介$$
($$千鳥$$ is definitely her... But what is this...)

544:t_2:401.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I missed you so much. Even now, I'm just bursting with the urge to throw myself into your arms.」

544:t_2:402.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Then why are you doing this?」

544:t_2:403.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I have important work I have to do. Important work $$ソフィア$$ asked of me.」

544:t_2:404.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I love you very much, but if you get in my way, I'll have to kill you.」

544:t_2:406.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Then that's... the girl in the capsule...」

544:t_2:407.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I told you not to talk, $$テッサ$$.」

544:t_2:408.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$千鳥$$, if this is a joke, stop it. This is no time for that.」

544:t_2:409.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yeah, I know. ...I wish it were a joke... That's the thought you're desperately clinging to right now, isn't it?」

544:t_2:410.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I understand why you're confused. But please, find the courage to accept it.」

544:t_2:411.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Because doing that will lead to the power to make this world better.」

544:t_2:414.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Let me go, just like this. If you don't, I'll kill $$テッサ$$, and you'll die too.」

544:t_2:416.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't talk nonsense...! Put the gun down and let her go!」

544:t_2:418.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I decide what I do! No one can control me! Not even you, $$宗介$$ - I won't allow that!」
